title: Finite geometric stalk tests for a constructible source
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and $F$ a constructible abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For $x\in X$, let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(x)}\to X$ be its residue-field algebraic-closure geometric point and write $F_{\bar x}$ for its geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There exists a finite subset $P\subset X$ such that every $F_{\bar x}$ for $x\in P$ is finite as a set, and for every abelian etale sheaf $G$ and every morphism $\phi:F\to G$, injectivity of $\phi_{\bar x}$ for all $x\in P$ implies that $\phi$ is a monomorphism. There is no finiteness condition on $G$, and $P$ depends only on $F$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-irreducible-lisse-strata] to choose finitely many nonempty irreducible locally closed strata where F is finite locally constant. Each scheme stratum has a generic point. Let P be the finite set of images of these generic points in X. At an image x use the geometric point Spec of the algebraic closure of kappa(x). An immersion induces an isomorphism on residue fields, so this geometric point lifts to the generic point of its stratum. In Lean genericPoint_spec supplies the generic points. Scheme.exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range (WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.UniversalHomeomorphism) supplies the lifts because immersions are surjective on stalks; injectivity of an immersion forces each lift to have image the selected generic point.

The natural inverse-image stalk isomorphism [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar] identifies the stalk of the abelian restriction of F with the original stalk at x. Forgetting abelian-group structure commutes with inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures] and with stalks (Point.sheafFiberCompIso for forget). Thus the finite set-valued stalk of the lisse restriction transfers to a finite underlying set of the abelian stalk of F at x.

Let G be any abelian etale sheaf and phi:F to G have injective stalk maps at P. Naturality of the inverse-image stalk isomorphism [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar] identifies each restricted generic stalk map with the given map at its image in P. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-generic-kernel] to each stratum to deduce that its restricted map is mono; finite local constancy of the set restriction gives the required local constancy of the underlying abelian restriction by the inverse-image/forget comparison.

Every residue-field algebraic-closure point of X lifts through a stratum immersion whose image contains its underlying point, by Scheme.exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range. The restricted morphism is mono by step 3. Finite-limit preservation of geometric stalks [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact] keeps it mono on the lifted stalk. Naturality of the inverse-image stalk isomorphism [lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar] transports this to a mono on the original stalk. To show phi is mono, take two maps a,b into F with a followed by phi equal to b followed by phi. Apply every residue-field algebraic-closure stalk and cancel its mono phi map. The geometric-stalk extensionality theorem Scheme.sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint, in the same source module as [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] and proved from joint faithfulness of the conservative family, gives a=b. This replaces the planned kernel-zero argument by direct cancellation. On empty X the stratification has no nonempty strata and the same argument applies vacuously with P empty.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_stalk_tests_of_constructible (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F)) : ∃ P : Finset X, (∀ x : P, Finite (((pointSmallEtale (X.algClosurePoint x.val)).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F)) ∧ (∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : F ⟶ G), (∀ x : P, Function.Injective (((pointSmallEtale (X.algClosurePoint x.val)).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map φ)) → Mono φ)
